test_index_repr_valid_construction: test that repr(Index) produces valid Python construction code that reconstructs the original Index
test_string_index_repr: test string Index repr output for ASCII and Unicode indices with short, multi-line, and truncated formats
test_string_index_repr_unicode_option: test string Index repr output with display.unicode.east_asian_width option enabled
test_index_repr_summary_truncation: test Index repr summary truncation with display.max_seq_items option set
test_index_summary_no_formatting: test that Index._summary() does not accidentally format special characters like %s or curly braces
